title: Diwali 2026 in the UAE: Fireworks, Festivals, Temples and Where to Celebrate
excerpt: Main Diwali falls on Sunday, November 8, with Dubai's Festival of Lights running November 2-12 and Noor at Souk Al Seef on November 6-8.
body:
• Diwali's main day in the UAE is Sunday, November 8, 2026, with the five days running from Dhanteras on November 6 to Bhai Dooj on November 10.
  • Dubai's official Festival of Lights runs November 2-12, centred on Noor: Festival of Lights at Souk Al Seef on November 6-8, with processions, dance, live music, workshops and fireworks over Dubai Creek.
  • No official 2026 fireworks schedule had been published at the time the guides were updated — displays at Al Seef, Global Village and Dubai Festival City are expected from past years, and personal fireworks are prohibited in the UAE.
  • Reader plan: pray at Hindu Temple Dubai in Jebel Ali or Krishna Mandir in Bur Dubai, shop the Dubai Jewellery Group campaign (October 24-November 12, raffles totalling 1kg of gold) on Dhanteras, and note Diwali is not a UAE public holiday — the main day falls on a Sunday in 2026.

For the UAE's large Indian community, Diwali 2026 arrives on Sunday, November 8 — and Dubai is building an 11-day citywide celebration around it. Dubai's official Festival of Lights runs from November 2 to 12, bracketing the five traditional days of the festival with temple visits, gold shopping, community events and the Noor festival on Dubai Creek.

The dates to mark

According to the UAE Mercury Diwali guide, the five days run from Dhanteras on Friday, November 6, through Choti Diwali on November 7, main Diwali and Lakshmi Puja on Sunday, November 8, Govardhan Puja on November 9 and Bhai Dooj on Tuesday, November 10. Lakshmi Puja falls on the evening of November 8 after sunset. Several older pages still circulating show October dates — those are last year's calendar recycled.

Where to celebrate in Dubai

The centrepiece is Noor: Festival of Lights at Souk Al Seef from November 6 to 8, presented with Dubai Festivals and Retail Establishment and the Consulate General of India in Dubai. The UAE Diwali guide lists processions, storytelling, dance, live music, interactive experiences, stand-up comedy, workshops and fireworks as part of the programme.

On the main day itself, Diwali in the Park runs at the JLT Park Amphitheatre on November 8 from 5 p.m. to 9 p.m. as a free community celebration. Dubai Holding communities — including Al Furjan, Jumeirah Village Circle, Jumeirah Village Triangle, Remraam, Serena, Discovery Gardens, The Villa and Villanova — host their own events with rangoli, lanterns, cultural performances and photo zones. Global Village's India Pavilion adds Bollywood entertainment and Diwali food stalls, while malls across the city run decor, pop-up bazaars and dance performances. Dubai Miracle Garden lists a Bollywood Blooms Pop-Up Market from November 1 to 14.

Bur Dubai and Meena Bazaar remain the community heartland, with balconies strung with lights and mithai shops at their busiest of the year.

Fireworks: what is confirmed and what is not

Be careful with fireworks lists circulating online. At the time the guides were last updated, no official 2026 Diwali fireworks schedule with venues and times had been published. Based on past years, displays are expected at Al Seef during the Noor Festival nights, at Global Village — which runs regular 9 p.m. fireworks through the season — and as a Diwali-themed show at Dubai Festival City. One rule is firm: personal fireworks and firecrackers are prohibited in the UAE; only licensed official displays take place.

Temples and gold

Dubai's main Hindu temple is now Hindu Temple Dubai in Jebel Ali, opened in October 2022 and home to 16 deities; the old Bur Dubai Shiva Mandir relocated there in January 2024, while Krishna Mandir remains at the Bur Dubai complex near Dubai Museum. Both draw very large crowds across the Diwali days, and the Jebel Ali temple has used online registration on peak days, so check before you go and arrive early.

For Dhanteras shopping, the Dubai Jewellery Group's Diwali campaign runs from October 24 to November 12 across participating jewellers, with offers and raffles totalling 1kg of gold. Expect the biggest crowds at the Gold Souk in Deira and the jewellers of Meena Bazaar on Dhanteras and the main Diwali weekend.

Practical notes for visitors

Diwali is not an official UAE public holiday, though some private companies and Indian-curriculum schools grant leave by their own policy. In 2026 the main day helpfully falls on a Sunday. Festivals, mall celebrations, community events and temple visits are open to everyone, making the period an easy add-on for visitors already in Dubai — book restaurants early for the main weekend and use public transport around major venues where possible.
